messages.subject: A mapview error on shinyapps.io
parts:
Dear all,

I have built a shiny app using mapview package to show an interactive map. It can run locally, but when I deployed it to shinyapps.io, the mapview output showed the following error message: unused argument (label = label)

My first guess would be some issues about package version, but I am using mapview 1.1 on my laptop, which is the latest version on cran. Does anyone have an idea how to fix this error?

Yu-Chen
